llmSummary: This assignment requires you to have calculated your 1-Rep Max (1RM) values within the last 14 days. Build a 4-week Linear Periodization Macro-Cycle spreadsheet for a chosen goal (Strength, Hypertrophy, or Power), using percentage-based progression for core lifts and a scheduled deload week.
reasoning: A structured spreadsheet with weekly calculations for several lifts and a deload week is a few hours of careful work. The percentage-based progression formulas make it moderately demanding.
